newsitem.title: USA: Senate passes airline tax extension.
newsitem.headline: Senate passes airline tax extension.

text.p: The Senate Thursday approved a bill to reimpose the 10 percent airline ticket tax, clearing it for President Clinton's signature.
The ticket tax expired Dec. 31. The bill would reinstate the tax until Sept. 30, the end of the government's fiscal year.
The bill would be effective seven days after the date of enactment.

Supporters of the bill say revenues from the tax were needed to keep the airport and airways trust fund from running out of money next month. The fund is also used to pay for improvements at airports and the air traffic control system.
Several major airlines say the tax is unfair to them and have asked Congress to replace it with user fees.
